title: narcissus asturiensis subsp. brevicoronatus
intro: Narcissus asturiensis subsp. brevicoronatus, commonly known as the Asturian narcissus, is a subspecies of bulbous perennial plant in the Amaryllidaceae family. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of the plant include promoting relaxation, reducing stress, and exhibiting potential anti-cancer properties, primarily due to its bioactive constituents. These constituents include alkaloids such as galantamine, which is responsible for the plant's bioactive properties and has been studied for its potential therapeutic applications.
